rows.grounds: Ablative of reason formed from a compound: those of limited vision cannot conceive it.

items.question: Why is the Lord beyond conceptualization by those with limited vision?
premises: Some seers possess limited vision.
The Lord exceeds the scope of limited cognition.
What exceeds limited cognition cannot be imagined by it.
items.inference: Therefore the Lord is unimaginable for those of limited vision.
items.plain_english: Because those with limited vision cannot conceive of him.

rows.grounds: Direct object of worship.

items.question: By what means should one worship the Lord in this ritual context?
premises: The Lord is the object of worship.
Ritual worship requires a prescribed means.
The a-varga is specified as that means.
items.inference: Therefore one should worship the Lord with the a-varga.
uncertainties: The exact technical scope of avarga in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: One should worship the Lord with the a-varga.

rows.grounds: Predicate adjective or gerundive indicating fitness for worship.

items.question: What status is attributed to the divine presence in this context?

items.question: Does possessing form create any doctrinal incongruity for the Lord?
premises: The Lord may be considered as having form.
Having form might be thought to imply limitation.
No incongruity is admitted in this case.
items.inference: Therefore even having form entails no incongruity for the Lord.
items.plain_english: Even if he has form, there is no incongruity at all.

items.plain_english: And this sequential practice is useful for the arrangements that will occur in the second and later chapters.

items.question: What effect does mere ritual placement have on the practitioner's sense of limitation?

items.question: How should the practitioner visualize emergence through the barrier of consciousness?
premises: A barrier described as a wall of consciousness is posited.

items.inference: Therefore one should imagine and meditate on having pierced the wall of consciousness and emerged.
items.plain_english: Having pierced the wall of consciousness-form, one should imagine and meditate on what has emerged.

items.question: What is the essential purpose of performing the placement of the kalās?
premises: The placement of kalās is a prescribed ritual act.
Ritual acts serve a specific purpose.
The stated purpose is to show the pervasion of Īśāna.
items.inference: Therefore the placement of kalās is to be done to show the pervasion of Īśāna.
items.plain_english: The condensed meaning is that the placement of the kalās should be done to show the pervasion of Īśāna.
